body.text: T4 review: [feature] priority P4, urgency low, reasons threshold:category, ticket_ref 20c2eabef81ee1a9b17e

body.llm_input:
Subject: Reporting wish list

Hi team,

We have used your reporting module for a year, and our managers asked me to collect everything we miss in one place. Here is the full list, in order of importance:

1. Saved report views: let us save a filtered report with its columns and sort order, and share it with the team.
2. Scheduled exports: send a saved view as a file to a list of people every week, on a day we choose.
3. Cross-workspace reports: we run three workspaces and today we merge their numbers by hand every month.
4. Custom date ranges: the fixed ranges (7, 30 and 90 days) do not match our fiscal quarters, which start in February.
5. Goal lines on charts: a target line on the weekly chart would make the dashboard much easier to read in meetings.
6. Drill-down: clicking a bar in a chart should open the list of records behind that number.
7. Annotations: we would like to add a short note to a day on a chart, for example 'pricing change' or 'campaign start'.
8. Report permissions: some reports should be visible to managers only, while others can be shared with the whole team.
9. Comparisons: show this period next to the same period last year, with the difference in percent.
10. Embeds: a read-only link to a single chart that we can place on our internal wiki page.
11. Better CSV: keep number formats and add the report name and date range to the top of every export.
12. Templates: a few ready-made report templates for common questions would help new team members start faster.
